explication: AlpaSim is a modular autonomous-driving research simulator. A researcher configures a run, the runtime schedules closed-loop rollouts, and policy, traffic, physics, controller, and sensor-rendering services provide successive simulation results for evaluation. The graph also preserves configuration/deployment, plugin extensibility, and log replay as distinct capabilities. README descriptions and the file tree support the broad service map; sampled excerpts confirm portions of runtime orchestration, controller invocation, and evaluation aggregation, but not every service call, so uncertain wiring is omitted.
